# has geocode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGeocode`](gmeow-hasGeocode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGeocode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Relates a place to an alternative geocoding identifier expressed in a specific reference frame. Non-functional: a place may have multiple geocodes in different systems, and competing geocodes for the same system may coexist as standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) -> [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasGeocode`](gmeow-hasGeocode.md) from [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) to [`gmeow:Geocode`](../classes/gmeow-Geocode.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
